content.text: {"id": "mm5817a3", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Smaller counties were more likely to follow their policies or guidelines than were larger counties (p=0.03)."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Among the 66 counties, 58 (88%) screened ≥75% of students in first, third, and sixth grades"}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Thirty-one counties (47%) used an acceptable electronic data system"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Fifty-one of 66 counties (77%) had policies or guidelines for measuring students' weight, height, or BMI percentile."}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "Nineteen counties (29%) were training ≥90% of their screeners, and 21 (32%) consistently used appropriate equipment"}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Smaller counties were more likely to use an appropriate stadiometer or weight scale than were larger counties (p < 0.01)."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Almost all small counties (36 of 37 counties, 97%) screened ≥75% of students for BMI in first grade"}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "cross-sectional", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "The survey was conducted by e-mailing an electronic survey link to identified coordinators"}]}, {"v": "evaluation or monitoring", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "surveyed school health coordinators in Florida's 67 counties to assess qualities of BMI screening activities"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Chi-square test was used to test differences within categories."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "A p-value ≤0.05 was considered as statistically significant."}, {"loc": "note", "q": "P-value ≤0.05, two-tailed based on chi-square test."}], "confidence": "medium", "uncertain_fields": ["study_design"]}
